items.title: Dave Rivello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: Penfield High School and runs the Penfield Music Commission Project, and every year I write for them.

ctx.x: Let’s talk about writing for school bands. What’s the key to writing for, like a middle school band, for you?

The key for me, and this is what I’ve tried to do with the Alfred pieces that I’ve written and I write a lot for the Penfield School system too here, and I don’t actually honestly know what it is that Jim Doser, I don’t know if you know, but Jim is great. Penfield High School and runs the Penfield Music Commission Project, and every year I write for them. And I don’t know exactly what it is that he hears, but somehow he says I have an ability to really do that for younger players in a way that a lot of other…
Sure. I mean you obviously have to know about ranges and what that age level —
